_comment: Category UUIDs read from public browse pages, not guessed. Keyed by UUID because slug is NOT unique - two different ids both carry cat.gma.PS5_Pro_Enhanced_Games. This list is a checked-in artifact: re-running the discovery does not reproduce it, because the browse pages are dynamically merchandised.
_plus_comment: Added 2026-09-22. Not from ngp/psplus.py's AEM feed (bin/imagic/gameslist) -- that endpoint started truncating its answer to ~55 of ~500 entries on 2026-09-19 and stayed broken. These are ordinary browse categories, same categoryGridRetrieve operation as everything else here, discovered the same way (public browse page, not guessed) and unaffected throughout.
